Rule.Name: XboxDeployment
Rule.Description: How the title is packaged and copied to the console.

Category.Name: Console
Category.Description: How the title is copied to the devkit on deploy.

Category.Name: Media
Category.Description: Files that ship with the title.

StringProperty.Name: RxdkRemotePath
StringProperty.Description: Console directory the title deploys to (e.g. xe:\MyGame). Defaults to xe:\<project name>.

BoolProperty.Name: RxdkForceCopy
BoolProperty.Description: No (default): incremental deploy -- copy only files new or newer than the console copy (xbcp -d), so unchanged media is skipped. Yes: always re-copy every file.

StringListProperty.Name: RxdkDeployPaths
StringListProperty.Description: Project-relative files or directories staged next to default.xbe -- into the ISO and copied to the console on deploy, e.g. Media. The title's runtime media.

BoolProperty.Name: RxdkCreateIso
BoolProperty.Description: Pack the build output into an .iso with xdvdfs. Set to No to stop at the .xbe (plus staged deploy files).
